items.title: UK PM vows to fight for job after rival's stunning by-election win
items.description: Sir Keir Starmer's principal rival, Andy Burnham, has stormed back into parliament after a near-decade absence with a by-election win.

items.title: Israel and Hezbollah agree ceasefire as US-Iran deal under strain
items.description: Fighting escalated between Israel and Hezbollah in south Lebanon overnight, with reports of more than 18 people killed in Israeli strikes and four Israeli soldiers killed.

items.title: 'Astonished': Meloni hits back at Trump's claim she 'begged' him for photo
items.description: The Italian prime minister accused her one-time close ally of fabricating a story about her, after the US President told an Italian TV channel that she had "begged" him to take a photo with her at a G7 summit.

items.title: Hawks break drought at Carrara, winning tough encounter against Suns
items.description: The Hawks win at Carrara for the first time since 2014, after a tough, physical encounter against the Suns.

items.title: Crucial miss sinks Dragons as Knights survive massive scare at home
items.description: The Newcastle Knights have provisionally moved into the NRL top four with a 22-20 win over the St George Illawarra Dragons. Follow live.

items.title: 'I'm going to stay with you': Woman comes to Modra's aid moments after truck crash
items.description: Linda Cameron describes how she rendered first aid to the former Crows player and held his hand as they waited for an ambulance following a truck crash in South Australia's Fleurieu Peninsula.

items.title: KMPG 'not full of bad apples', former CEO says during parliamentary grilling
items.description: Federal senators have accused senior leaders in Australia's accounting and auditing industry of behaving disgracefully as more revelations emerge about KPMG's whistleblower scandal.

items.title: Suspected H5 bird flu detected in Australia
items.description: A wild migratory bird in Western Australia has returned a suspected positive result for avian influenza, which has devastated populations of seabirds, seals and other animals across the world.

items.title: From a White House podium, Vance delivers 'stunning development' on Israel
items.description: The US vice-president takes public aim at Israel with a series of comments Washington watchers say are "unprecedented".

items.title: Australia's belief has been a long time coming. The United States are wary of it
items.description: When USA coach Mauricio Pochettino was asked about Australia's strengths ahead of the two sides' World Cup meeting in Seattle, he settled on a word — belief.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
